name: ai-payroll
description: Anguilla Universal Social Levy (USL) for ordinary monthly employee and employer remuneration in 2026. Covers the separate 3% employee and 3% employer liabilities, the XCD 2,000 monthly remuneration exemption, the XCD 12,000 employer wage limit, conditional telephone and travel allowances, deduction at payment, the monthly return and remittance within 10 days, termination remittance, nil returns and the late filing penalty. Use for Anguilla payroll, employee levy, employer levy, USL returns or monthly remuneration. Self-employed levy, Social Security, non-monthly conversion and disputed employment require additional sources. Built from the unofficial online consolidation dated 31 December 2022, checked against the IRD's 2026 USL page; later amendments remain unverified and the skill awaits review by a qualified professional in Anguilla.
